# Full job description
**As a Senior Advanced Manufacturing Engineer You Will:**
* Lead the development of new manufacturing and assembly processes from concept through production implementation with a focus on improved accuracy, reliability, and reduced cost.
* Design and develop assembly equipment, fixtures, tooling, and validation methods to support new product introductions and process improvements
* Apply advanced GD&T principles to product and tooling designs, ensuring manufacturability, repeatability, and quality
* Create and modify 3D models, assemblies and tooling concepts using CAD software
* Partner with product engineering teams to drive Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) improvements throughout the product development cycle
* Evaluate, develop, and implement emerging assembly technologies including presses, vision systems, automated fastening, dispensing systems, laser processing, and intelligent manufacturing solutions
* Work directly with machine integrators, automation suppliers, and equipment builders to define requirements, review designs, and commission production equipment
* Develop proof-of-concept prototypes and conduct hands-on experimentation in a laboratory environment to validate manufacturing processes and technologies
* Utilize Python programming to automate data collection, process analysis, equipment interfacing, and development of manufacturing tools
* Lead Process FMEA risk assessments, capability studies, and validation activities to ensure manufacturing readiness
* Support capital projects, equipment procurement, factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), and production startup activities
* Utilize effective problem-solving skills and develop temporary and permanent solutions to manufacturing issues
Align with all required safety and regulatory requirements

...

* Degree in Engineering Field (preferably Mechanical/ Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical/Manufacturing Engineering Technology, Electrical Engineering, or Industrial Engineering) or (10+) years of relevant manufacturing work experience in lieu of degree
* Minimum of (5) years’ experience in a manufacturing environment
* Use of 2D/3D CAD programs (AutoCAD, NX, or equivalent)
* Extensive practical experience applying GD&T principles in product and tooling design

...

* Collaboration skills to integrate with multiple levels of the organization
* Proven understanding of Lean Manufacturing and its methodologies
* Proven experience implementing DFM and DFA methodologies
* Understanding of assembly processes
* Theoretical and practical understanding of process control
* Proficiency in Python programming for engineering and manufacturing applications
* Capital equipment procurement experience.

...

sourceEvidence.quote:
**Role
** As a Digitization Tool Engineering Manager, your role will be to serve as the Leader accountable over a small team of tool engineers (direct and contract), as well as vendors performing scans. You will:
* Manage cost, schedule, and technical objectives of the digitization effort
* Coordinate and interact with all supporting functional organizations (tooling departments, Jig Shop, Tool Inspection, Tool Control, etc…) to ensure scanning effort adheres to cost and schedule expectations
* Resolve any constraints that will impede scanning execution and escalate as needed
* Be accountable for setting strategic direction, making decisions, allocating resources, fostering collaboration, and driving the overall execution of the Digitization scanning effort
* Prepare reports and brief Sr Leadership on progress and identification of process improvements
* Own the Digitization scanning area and ensure its readiness to support schedule demands
* Monitor and own the execution of vendors / suppliers
* Establish a culture of performance and results
The ideal candidate will possess a background around tool engineering and metrology. The candidate must excel in cross-functional collaboration, exhibit strong organizational and project management capabilities, and quickly develop relationships to influence outcomes. Additionally, the candidate must establish a culture of performance
This position is located in <a href=https://www.lockheedmartinjobs.com/aero-marietta-georgia> Marietta, GA.
This role may require infrequent travel and possible weekend/off-hour support.
Designs, develops and implements industrial machinery and equipment, tools, dies, gauges, jigs, fixtures, prototype model production and machine attachments required for production or experimental use, considering such factors as accessibility, economy, mobility, and performance requirements.
Responsible for coordinating subordinate employee recruitment, selection and training, performance assessment, work assignments, salary, and recognition/disciplinary actions. May use CAD/CAM to design tools.
Proficient in AI prompting as it applies to this position and practice.
**Basic Qualifications
**
* Bachelor’s degree (STEM required)
* 8+ years of experience in production engineering / engineering / lead / supervisory / managerial role
* Experience with tooling lifecycles and processes (i.e. tool design, design review, procurement, funding, etc.)
* Demonstrated ability to work strategically as well as tactically to drive operations
* Ability to liaison between Production Operations, Manufacturing Sites, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, etc.
* Ability to build positive relationships with the customer
* Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve technical/process issues varying from basic to very complex
* Experience managing safety, quality, cost, schedule, and the reporting up of those metrics
* Excellent presentation, verbal & written communication skills
**Desired Skills
**
* Experience with the Aeronautics Line of Business and awareness of Aero Code and local site policies and procedures
* Experience developing and implementing tools required for production or experimental use
* Experience in design for manufacturing / assembly or design for cost
* Demonstrated ability to interpret complex engineering drawings, geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T), and manufacturing requirements
* Experience supporting military aircraft programs, including C-130, C-130J, or other legacy aircraft platforms.
* Experience with fabrication tooling, assembly tooling, master gauges, templates, fixtures, and drill jigs
* Familiarity with tooling inspection, metrology, laser tracking, 3D scanning, and digital tooling verification
* Experience with tooling digitization, legacy drawing conversion, model-based definition, and configuration management.
* CATIA V5 and / or NX experience
* Demonstrated ability to lead high performing engineering teams, manage budgets, and influence cross functional stakeholders
* Experience interfacing with executive leadership across functions and lines of business
* Experience managing or interfacing with contracted employees
* Earned Value Management experience & systems knowledge
* Project Management, Project Engineering, or Production Engineering Experience
* Ability to plan strategically and translate strategies into daily, weekly and monthly tactical actions and tasks
**Pay Information
** Full-Time Salary Range: $129000.00 - $239600.00
At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.
